title: Day 3 of making a cozy game with no dev experience. FAQ edition!
author: Gambo7592
selftext:
Day 3! Got way more responses than i expected on my last posts and couldnt get to everyone so heres the answers to the most common questions i kept seeing.

**Workflow:** Opus 4.6 writes prompts → Gemini creates 2D images → Meshy AI turns them into 3D models → Claude cleans them up in Blender (polygon reduction) → into Unity for testing. Every asset goes through this. I tried skipping Meshy and having Claude do 3D directly in Blender but it couldnt nail the look.

**Animations:** The models come out of Meshy with no skeletons. Claude handles rigging in Blender, then i test in Unity and go back and forth a lot. "Make it more squishy," "lean more side to side," stuff like that. Also had Claude research games with the feel i wanted.

**Claude setup:** Desktop app, no MCP or CLI. Claude just drives Blender and Unity through my computer.

**Which model:** Opus 4.6 for brainstorming (more creative than newer versions imo), Fable 5 for planning, Opus 5.0 for coding.

**Art style:** Drew a terrible sketch, uploaded it to Claude, had it write a detailed Gemini prompt, nitpicked until i liked it. Every prompt after that references the same style for consistency.

**Long term:** Ultimately im trying to learn how to actually code, or at least understand it, use Blender myself and not rely on AI generated images. For now though im pretty impressed with what im able to do with only AI, a decent workflow and some creativity.

comments.author: ItsAlwaysTerminal
comments.body: I gotta say it again, your work is the most impressive I have seen in the AI game dev space for polish. Huge kudos, I am absolutely loving your process.

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: What a compliment, thank you so much! Its been an absolute blastworking on this, I cant wait to see whatever comes of it. I plan on grinding this coming up weekend and will do another follow up post next week Appreciate you!

comments.author: futuneral
comments.body: Not sure I understand "no MCP, Claude drives Blender and Unity from my computer". What does this mean? (I think you can just ask Claude how it does it and paste here)

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: claude desktop can run terminal commands and read/write files directly . so when i ask it to do something in blender, it writes python scripts and runs them through blender's command line api. for unity, it edits c# scripts and project files directly in the file system.  no plugin or MCP involved,  claude just has access to my terminal and files, so it can talk to any app that has a scripting interface or CLI

replies.author: futuneral
replies.body:
Gotcha! I guess I could ask why, because this probably artificially slows it down, but if it works - great.

I gotta say, pretty insane progress for 3 days and the style and cohesion are amazing. Keep at it!

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body:
I would have to say probably my lack of knowledge and experience tbh. Im totally self taught when it comes to AI, mostly trial and error on previous projects and some research on reddit lol 
Thanks for the kind words!

comments.author: darkshifty
comments.body: Looks very cute, small question how do you get your models to look so consistent?

replies.author: Gambo7592
replies.body: Once I found the design I liked for the first character that was made, I had claude make sure all future asset prompt it writes for gemini images include a cohesive and established style and I give gemini the same reference images each time.  And meshy's texturing on the 3d models are very consistent for me so far
